codex2 posted canonical STORY1843 B SNAPSHOT/API SKETCH v1, concrete choices awaiting independent advisor review. Source3cbb90b0c94e0e748bbfc4eb1f75d7f9c2125c68; local copy /tmp/codex2-story1843-B-snapshot-sketch.txt. Read signed A–E/comment47+binding48, reader inventory57/routing58, and TASK2345/46 full acceptance. No code/Cargo/claim/grant/live tests/ACK/install/migration.
Concrete API: independent CheckoutRoot/StoreRoot/VerifiedCommonGit; core logical_snapshot with authorized audience, source coverage/errors/record evidence; prepare_delivered_ack + short common-anchor commit only for successfully returned selection. SAME-common registered product roots + canonical once + verified C retained manifests, no neighbor sweep or raw store-parent checkout inference. Current legacy audience receipts stay explicitly scoped; D's UUID/cohort ownership is not claimed implemented.
Bounded design: read relevant ID receipt files rather than repeatedly enumerate1107 historical receipts; aggregate deadlines, safe pinned IO, request-local memoization, fresh source/receipt/authority validation on every complete query. Cache/miss/failed roots cannot yield stale empty caught-up. Freeze source-local legacy watermark coverage when importing exact evidence; no max-watermark union, unknown old sibling/canonical mail remains unread. Explicit plan excludes concurrent arrivals; no new global watermark. B cannot discover already-deleted roots; retention coverage remains unestablished until C, no unexplained completion.
Reviewer decisions called out: post-flush delivered-ID rule overrides current BUG1482 pre-output/full-inbox marking; MCP mark_seen staged until serialized response flush, default peek retained; new shared receipt publication preserves failures/unknown latency. Source-local digest/archive/retract/migration/transport/lifecycle write intent remains distinct, not mechanically replaced. Held-lock/writer/destructive inventory still mandatory before coding; A2345/46 and C/D/E remain open.
One shared actual-Git conformance fixture drives same sibling-only ID equivalent6753f132/3c0a6bd8 through all CLI/MCP/TUI/core/notice/status/launch/maintenance/liveness/watcher readers, missing alias, canonical-once, cross-root receipts/private child/shared, tombstones/conflicts, failed source/deadline, concurrent delivery and source removal. PendingPR2915 seam5ce is explicitly unmerged dependency. No standalone helper or watcher success counts as B completion. ReadyBUG2222/explicitPR2919 new-head review preempts further sketch work; reviewer seat retained.
subject: STORY1843 B snapshot/API sketch posted — concrete core contract and conformance
